import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('an arrow function', () => {
  it('is followed by a call', () => {
    const add = (a: number, b: number): number => {
      const sum = a + b;
      return sum;
    };
    expect(add(1, 2)).toBe(3);
    const multiply = (
      a: number,
      b: number,
    ): number => a * b;
    expect(multiply(2, 3)).toBe(6);
  });
});
